snippet.title: SnekromancY - A new snake-like bullet heaven, coming soon!
snippet.description:
Free demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4314770/SnekromancY/

Slither through a maze-like dungeon, devouring enemies and gobbling up treasure to summon an unstoppable horde in this twist on a classic.
